justifications.unit: Every line is exercised by the unit tests, including tag tracking, tag removal, pattern removal and the redacted log paths; measured 100%.
justifications.guard: Guard tests build a real HybridCache through DI and run the constructor null checks, the null-argument and pre-cancelled-token checks of every public method, and the valid paths: get hit and miss, set, sliding set, tagged and untagged get-or-set, and key, tag, tag-pattern and glob-pattern removal after tag tracking.
